Charilaos","email":"mylonas.charilaos@gmail.com","date":"2026-09-13T23:56:57Z"},"message":"Make tf_gnns agent benchmarks pass by improving user docs

Benchmarks now pass 8/8 under ollama/qwen3.8 with the packaged
tf-gnns-user-docs skill. The main changes:

- Expand agent_skill references: multi-graph batching, subgraph
  extraction with edge_trimming_mode, assign_global check_shape,
  GraphNetMLP with globals and explicit sizes, factory config with
  composite aggregation and eval_tensor_dict/graph_tuple_eval parity,
  SparseGCN edge weights and dtypes, documented GCNv2 ValueError
  boundaries.
- Add Environment/Agent Workflow guidance to SKILL.md so agents use
  the uv project env and the docs tool instead of probing the
  environment or reading library source.
- Tighten the suite agent_prompt (read the matching topic, write the
  solution immediately, avoid env spelunking) and raise task timeouts
  to 600s.
- Run validation commands with uv run python; add agent_docs CLI,
  API index generator, docs tests, and lazy package-root exports.
- Ignore Charilaos","email":"mylonas.charilaos@gmail.com","date":"2026-09-14T11:37:27Z"},"message":"Restructure agent docs concept-first; fix GraphNetMLP global contract; shift benchmark params

Concept-first topic pages: every reference page now leads with How It
Works, Decision Guide, Parameter Key Facts, Boundaries & Gotchas, and a
Minimal Skeleton before Rules/API Signatures/Output Contract, with
examples moved to a final Example Gallery. Agent_docs gains a --concepts
extraction mode and the SKILL.md and benchmark suite agent_prompt now
direct agents to read concepts first and treat examples as reference,
not templates.

Docs accuracy fixes: GraphNetMLP always builds a global block and fails
without global_attr + repetition keys (verified against models/
graphnet.py); the no-global path is GraphNetMPNN_MLP only. Example
Gallery now shows reading object-graph edge widths via edge_tensor.

API index: generator now unions root and submodule __all__ but keeps a
submodule name only when the reference docs mention it (GCNv2 added,
maybe_patch_ld_library_path_for_tensorflow excluded), and filters
underscore-prefixed names.

Benchmark shifts: tasks 09-14 parametrize so copy-pasting doc examples
fails (units/widths/cores/reps/training paths all diverge from the docs).
Trace rules flag examples-before-concepts retrieval and /tmp probe
scripts. New reference solutions verified for all six shifted
